technical.summary: Mixed technicals with bullish micro-signals (supertrend, MACD) undermined by bearish macro structure (death cross, price below all MAs, weak ADX), creating low-probability swing entry despite squeeze setup.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings in 5 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-equivalent 30) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and aged (113+ days old) with no directional conviction; news data unavailable to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (339.84) combined with earnings binary event in 5 days creates severe near-term risk for MMM despite normal yield curve.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish + MACD bullish + squeeze positive with price at support (126.513) in extreme fear zone (VIX 339.84) creates contrarian micro-setup for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Death cross, price below all major MAs, weak ADX (11.92), RSI at 40, zero fundamental conviction, and critical earnings binary in 5 days during macro crisis regime make this a high-risk low-probability entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While supertrend and MACD show micro-bullish signals at support in extreme fear, the death cross, price below all major MAs, and weak ADX (11.92) indicate no macro trend confirmation. Earnings binary in 5 days during VIX crisis regime creates unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.
